title: Faculty Info Lecturer on Education Degrees Ed.D., Harvard University, (1986)
bio: Lisa Lahey was most recently the associate director of the Change Leadership Group, a national project funded by the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation to develop greater internal capacity for leading organizational improvement in U.S. public school districts.
research_interests: With deep expertise that connects research
